title: One Fish Poops Up to 1,000 Pounds of Beach Sand a Year

scenes.text: Some parrotfish poop up to 1,000 pounds of sand a year.
They spend their days scraping algae off coral and swallowing bits of it.
Their gut grinds the hard coral into fine white powder.
Then it comes out the other end as sand.
A big humphead parrotfish can make almost 10,000 pounds a year.
So some of that perfect white beach you love has already been through a fish.

description:

first_comment: What is the strangest thing a beach is made of?
